items.html: And the reason for the matter, that AVI, which are beneath the beard of AA, have their vitality drawn into them from these two heads, the skull and the brain, as was said. And in the matter that AVI are equal, go out together and dwell together, therefore these two heads were compelled to reveal Atik in them in equal union as well. And therefore the Hesed of Atik clothed in the skull, and the Gevura in the brain, which is Hochma; then the Hesed was included in the Gevura and the Gevura in the Hesed, and they were equal.
